title: Resolution honoring dancer Carmen de Lavallade with a City day
summary: This resolution would declare March 6 as Carmen de Lavallade Day in New York City, marking the birthday of the dancer, choreographer and actress who died on December 29, 2025 at age 94. It celebrates her contributions to dance and theater, including her work with Alvin Ailey and the Metropolitan Opera, and her role in advancing diversity in the performing arts.
